### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A02 was not observed at all (0 of 200 traces); in the later window it appears in about 56 in 100 traces (113 of 200) and in every one of those traces it is the last event of the trace. [OCC002, POS002]
- A02 is reached from three activities. A16 and A19, which in the earlier window had no observed outgoing transitions and always occupied the final position, now lead to A02 in every observed occurrence, and their positions moved from the trace end (1.0) to about 0.85. A09's outgoing transitions, previously split roughly half to A14 and half to A13, now split roughly half to A02 and half to A13. [DIR006, DIR011, DIR014, POS009, POS010, POS005]
- A01, also unobserved earlier, occurs in about 15 in 100 later traces (30 of 200), typically around two-thirds of the way through the trace, and every observed A01 is directly followed by A16. A10 and A17, which previously sent about 52% and 31% of their outgoing transitions to A16, now send about 42% and 50% to A01 instead. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR007, DIR012]
- A09 is rerouted and much rarer: A07's edge to A09 (about 49% of A07's outgoing transitions) disappeared, replaced by a direct A07–A14 edge (about 51%); A14 gained an edge to A09 (about 14% of its outgoing) and A03 gained one (about 19%). A09 now occurs in about 20 in 100 traces (39 of 200, down from 73), repeats far less (about 0.4 vs 1.1 occurrences per trace) and sits later in the trace (mean position about 0.59 vs 0.26), while A14 sits earlier (about 0.20 vs 0.39). [DIR002, DIR004, DIR009, OCC009, POS005, POS008, LAG011, LAG014]
- A13 occurs in far fewer traces (about 8–9 in 100, down from 23) and later (mean position about 0.54 vs 0.28); its earlier frequent co-occurrence with A14 (about 23 in 100 traces) has nearly vanished (about 4 in 100), with A14 now usually running without A13. [OCC013, POS007, REL040]
- The relation profiles match a new closing step: in the later window, none of A03, A07, A09, A10, A13, A14, A16 or A19 occurs in a trace without A02 (their "without-A02" shares fell to zero), and A01 always precedes A02 when both occur. [REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL017, REL001]
- Smaller shifts: A03 (about 35 vs 30 in 100) and A07 (28 vs 23) occur somewhat more often, while A15 (about 8 vs 14) and A04, A06 and A12 (about 44 vs 51 in 100 each) occur somewhat less often. [OCC003, OCC007, OCC015, OCC004, OCC006, OCC012]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that two activities were added to the process. A02 behaves as a new final step: unobserved in the earlier window, it runs in about 56 in 100 later traces, always as the last event, and is reached from A16, A19 and A09 — A16 and A19 previously ended their traces and now lead to A02 in every observed occurrence, and about half of A09's outgoing transitions now go to A02 where they previously went to A14. A01 behaves as a new step before A16: unobserved earlier, present in about 15 in 100 later traces, always followed by A16, and it took over the transitions that A10 and A17 previously sent to A16. The signs are direct and consistent across the occurrence, direction, position and relation indicators — participation rising from zero to 30 and 113 of 200 traces, the successor profiles of A16, A19, A09, A10 and A17 changing exactly as this placement implies, and A16/A19 moving off the final position — and the occurrence differences are larger than in about 99.5% of random re-splits of the pooled data. [OCC001, OCC002, POS001, POS002, POS009, POS010, DIR001, DIR006, DIR007, DIR011, DIR012, DIR014, REL008, REL010]

Limitations: zero participation in the earlier window only shows that A01 and A02 were not observed there, so "added" cannot be distinguished from "previously present only in vanishingly rare variants"; many evidence items describe the same underlying appearance of the two activities and are not independent confirmations; and the roughly 44 in 100 later traces without A02 show the new step does not apply to every case. [OCC001, OCC002, POS002]

Other differences: In the A07 branch the order of A09 and A14 effectively reversed — A07 now leads directly to A14 (about half of its outgoing transitions, where it previously went to A09), A14 gained an edge to A09, A09 occurs in fewer traces (about 20 vs 37 in 100), repeats less and sits later, while A14 sits earlier; A13 has largely dropped out and now rarely runs together with A14; A03 gained a direct edge to A09 and occurs slightly more often (about 35 vs 30 in 100). [DIR002, DIR004, DIR009, REL025, REL033, OCC009, POS005, POS008, OCC013, REL040, OCC003]

A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is a shift in the case mix between the windows: the earlier sample may simply not have included traces of a variant containing A01 and A02, and the smaller few-percentage-point participation shifts could reflect sampling rather than a behavioural change. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC007, OCC015, OCC004]
